failure_summary.description: Agents chose a related term or entity instead of the answer slot indicated by the clue's exact wording.
Answers differed from the expected name form or omitted a necessary part of a canonical name.
A bare place-name prompt was echoed instead of using context to infer the intended country relation.

patch.reasoning: The main failures are already addressed by existing rules to identify the requested slot, follow clue wording, and return a canonical answer. Similar refinements to bare prompts and answer-form guidance were rejected in earlier steps, so another patch would risk repeating ineffective guidance or overfitting.
